source_instruction: i'm looking for a set of makeup brushes in the color peaceful purple to help me with my eyeshadow makeup.
query: Ugh, my cat just knocked over my favorite lavender candle all over my desk this morning, I spent 20 minutes picking wax out of my keyboard, and I still haven’t figured out if I should sign up for that weekend pottery class my roommate keeps raving about. Oh, and I saw a guy walking a pet duck on the sidewalk on my way here, it kept quacking at every dog that passed by, it was so funny I almost tripped over a fire hydrant. Anyway, since you probably don’t have standalone eye shadow in stock right now, can you show me alternatives from the makeup sets section in that nice peaceful purple shade, and make sure they’re under $30? Wait, no, actually, hold on—wait, no, I definitely want eye shadow, right? Wait no, no, the thing is, since eye shadow seems totally unavailable here, just grab me whatever close match you have in those sets, peaceful purple, under 30 bucks, yeah?

presupposed.text: since you probably don’t have standalone eye shadow in stock right now
